slots.checkpoints: E7-b frozen defense + its dedicated exploiters (no new training)

arms.base: no intervention (+ records residuals per segment = shuffle donor)
arms.out0: learned residual = 0 while |p_att - p_fin| > 16 m (pure homing approach)
arms.in0: learned residual = 0 while |p_att - p_fin| <= 16 m (16 m = existing window def.)
arms.zfix: skill z frozen at its episode-start draw (rng consumption unchanged)
arms.lat0: residual projected on the attacker->asset axis (lateral component removed)
arms.shuf_out: out-segment residual replaced by the base-arm residual sequence of another episode (donor = next seed in the slot, cyclic; k-th step uses donor[k mod len])

evaluation.paired: same 240 seeds in every arm (= E7-b seeds)
evaluation.env_seed: 0 for every worker (--env-seed). FINDING 2026-10-11: the default worker env is built with seed=os.getpid(), which leaks into the m4-stack RNG (v_fire-level differences, same labels in the smoke) -> prior canonical evals are distribution-equivalent but not bit-reproducible; AMI fixes it for cross-arm pairing
evaluation.cli: E7-b flags (--stack r4p --mu 0.35 --nu 1.0 + variant flags --coop-window --groups none) + --att-iv ARM [--att-donor] --env-seed 0

metric.primary: net = NET_CAPTURE + CAPTURE_WITH_CONTACT of the line defender vs its exploiter (ROE A: weaker attackers are also easier kinetic targets -> defended total is reported, never judged)
report: occupancy: episodes with >= 1 robust window tick, total robust ticks (coop-window n_rob)

gates.repro_check: base median net over 15 slots within ±6 of the E7-b net_det median (det line) / E7-b2 net_sto median (sto line); else INVALID_REPRO (pipeline fault, stop)
gates.LIFT(X): median_15 Δ_X >= +8 AND Δ_X > 0 in >= 10 of 15 slots (X in out0, in0, zfix, lat0)
gates.ADAPTIVE_S / ENERGY_S: for S in (out, in) with LIFT(S0): ADAPTIVE_S if median_15(Δ_S0 - Δ_shufS) >= 0.5 x median_15 Δ_S0 (shuffled residual of equal energy recovers less than half of the lift), else ENERGY_S

branch (det line = judgment).AMI_ADAPTIVE: any ADAPTIVE_S -> plateau carried by state-contingent residual in S
branch (det line = judgment).AMI_NOT_ATTACKER: no LIFT in (out0, in0, zfix, lat0) -> plateau not removable by these attacker-side ablations (defense-side candidate)

gates.sto line: same rules, replication only; disagreement -> report both as line-dependent
gates.dose: in_half: Δ reported with its position relative to Δ_in0 (report only)

e6_trigger (pre-registered both ways): AMI_ADAPTIVE or AMI_ATTACKER_NONADAPTIVE -> E6 (world a-change point at rho 3.92, a ~ 10.0, a_def fixed by mu' ~ 0.72, Lambda = V^2/(a R_max) named) becomes a conditional arm of the E1 contract; AMI_NOT_ATTACKER -> E6 deferred to the journal version.
